$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

Four quick-win defensive fixes across two components:

- **SelfieUpload — null guard on base64**: `dataUrl.split(',')[1]` can return `undefined` on a malformed data URL; now shows an error instead of silently passing `undefined` to the `onUpload` callback.
- **SelfieUpload — FileReader error/abort handlers**: `reader.onerror` and `reader.onabort` were unhandled, leaving the user with no feedback on read failure. Both now set a visible error message.
- **SelfieUpload — same-file re-upload**: Resetting `input.value = ''` after the read starts lets the user re-select the same file and have `onchange` fire again — previously it would silently do nothing.
- **WigCarousel — Array.isArray guard**: Wraps the JSON cast in a runtime array check so a malformed import renders an empty list instead of crashing the `{#each}` iteration.

## Test plan

- [ ] Upload a valid image → preview appears, no errors
- [ ] Upload the same image a second time → preview updates (same-file fix)
- [ ] (Manual/dev) Simulate a FileReader error → user sees error message
- [ ] Wig carousel loads and renders cards normally
- [ ] `npm run check` passes with 0 errors/warnings

https://claude.ai/code/session_01RZvpxb361SXSF4DtHYM1ck
EOF
)

## Summary by Sourcery

Harden file upload and wig carousel handling to be more resilient to malformed data and user error.

Bug Fixes:
- Prevent SelfieUpload from passing undefined base64 data to the upload handler when the FileReader data URL is malformed.
- Surface user-visible errors when the FileReader encounters read failures or is aborted during selfie upload.
- Allow re-uploading the same file in SelfieUpload by resetting the file input value after each read.
- Guard WigCarousel against non-array wig data so malformed JSON does not crash the carousel rendering.

- When handling `reader.onerror` and `reader.onabort`, you may also want to reset `previewUrl` to prevent a stale preview from being shown after a failed or cancelled read.

## Code Review

This pull request improves file reading robustness in `SelfieUpload.svelte` by handling reader errors, aborts, and missing base64 data, as well as resetting the input value. It also adds a basic array check for `wigData` in `WigCarousel.svelte`. Feedback suggests using a Zod schema to fully validate the structure of `wigData` at runtime to prevent crashes from malformed elements, and clearing the `previewUrl` in `SelfieUpload.svelte` when an upload fails to avoid displaying stale previews.
